Bad arthritis up and down spine and in shoulders.

I was always praying and had blind faith that modern medicine would catch up by the time I started breaking down. Thank GOD it did, with these stem cells. I did these instead of fusing three levels of my back, did these instead of getting a rod inserted in my spine, did these instead of major shoulder surgery to anchor back torn biceps tendon and staple two big rotator cuff tears.
